fonts.font_family_rule: font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif;

rules.labels: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

entry_surfaces./: RTL Command Center shell with role switcher in header: Manager view defaults to dense 4-stat KPI grid + Recharts attendance/leave charts + quick actions + active employee table; Employee view switches instantly to self-service check-in/out hero card + monthly attendance logs + leave request modal + payslip history

layout_architecture.shell_structure: Dual-mode responsive dashboard layout. Desktop: sticky top bar (with brand, mode-switcher, date, quick check-in) + clean navigation tabs; Main workspace: grid-based sections with ample spacing (gap-6 md:gap-8).

bento_grid.manager_kpi_row: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

employee_view_structure.hero_card: bg-gradient-to-l from-teal-900 to-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden

motion.tab_transitions: AnimatePresence with motion.div opacity and y-axis subtle shift (y: 6 to y: 0, 180ms easeOut)
motion.modal_animation: scale and fade entry with backdrop blur (blur-xs to blur-sm)

accessibility.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large graphical elements)
rtl_considerations: Use logical Tailwind spacing: ms-*, me-*, start-*, end-*, text-start, text-end
Ensure icons with directionality (arrows, chevrons) point in the correct RTL orientation
Ensure html element has dir="rtl" and lang="ar"
Calendar and DatePicker must render properly in RTL order
accessibility.test_attributes: Every interactive button, tab, input, modal trigger, and status badge MUST include descriptive kebab-case data-testid (e.g., data-testid='role-switcher-employee', data-testid='checkin-btn', data-testid='add-employee-btn', data-testid='payroll-generate-btn').

component_hierarchy.description: Header with app logo 'مواردي | Mawaridi HR', live Arabic Gregorian date/time, Role Switcher (مدير النظام / بوابة الموظف), Quick punch button, and theme toggle.

Manager executive hub: 4 KPI metric cards (إجمالي الموظفين, الحضور اليوم, طلبات الإجازة المعلقة, إجمالي مسير الرواتب), Attendance Trend bar chart, Leave request review list, and quick employee roster.
Complete Employee Directory: search/filter by job title or status, add employee modal with salary & allowance fields, edit profile, toggle active status, and detailed profile drawer.
Daily & Historical Attendance Log: filter by date, punch status, manual check-in/out override, export summary, and attendance rate indicator.
Leave Requests Manager: pending / approved / rejected tabs, quick approval/rejection with manager notes, annual balance tracking.

Monthly Payroll Generator: one-click monthly payroll batch generation, itemized salary breakdown (Base + Housing + Transport + Bonus - Deductions = Net), mark as paid, and printable/downloadable Arabic Payslip (مسير رواتب).

Employee Portal: Employee switcher dropdown ('أنت تتصفح كـ: أحمد المنصوري'), Clock-in / Clock-out card with live digital timer, monthly attendance summary, instant leave request submit form, and personal salary slip viewer.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup RTL & Arabic Language: Ensure `document.documentElement.dir = 'rtl'` and `lang = 'ar'` in index.html / main.tsx so all layouts naturally flow right-to-left.

2. Styling & Theme: Apply Tailwind v4 with `@import '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans';` in `frontend/src/index.css`. Use Slate-900 / Teal-600 color accents which provide a refined modern enterprise feel.

3. Role Switcher Contract: The user requested no mandatory auth login, but a clear distinction between MANAGER role (لوحة تحكم المدير) and EMPLOYEE role (بوابة الموظف الذاتية). Provide a toggle in the top bar to easily switch roles with zero reload friction.

4. Complete Functional Modules: Implement (1) Employees CRUD (إدارة الموظفين), (2) Attendance Check-in / Check-out with daily history (سجل الحضور والانصراف), (3) Leave Requests with approval/rejection (إدارة الإجازات), (4) Payroll calculation and disbursement marking (مسير الرواتب), and (5) Employee Self Service (بوابة الخدمة الذاتية).
5. Testing Readiness: Add `data-testid` to every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, selects, filters) for end-to-end and integration test verification.
6. Toast Notifications: Use Sonner `toast.success` and `toast.error` in Arabic with rich icons and clear feedback for all user actions.
